## Pressure switch on Arrhenius-form rates (`p-threshold`, `factor`) {#sec-ch06-pressure-switch}

### Summary

Some cloud microphysics parameterizations change a conversion rate below a given pressure. The pressure switch
multiplies an Arrhenius-form rate constant by a constant factor wherever the pressure is strictly below a
threshold. It applies to every rate form that uses the Arrhenius evaluator, including coagulation
(@sec-ch06-coagulation).

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** $k \leftarrow f\,k$ where $p < p_{\mathrm{th}}$, @eq-ch06-pressure-switch-factor.

**Data.** $p$ [Pa] in; $p_{\mathrm{th}}$ [Pa] and $f$ [-] per reaction.

**Placement.** Last step of the Arrhenius evaluator.

**Activation.** Keys `p-threshold` and `factor` under `rate-constant`, given together; default off.

**Guarantee / limits.** Strict inequality; discontinuous in $p$ at the threshold.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer.
:::

Local symbols: $p_{\mathrm{th}}$, threshold pressure [Pa]; $f$, switch factor [-].

A reaction without the keys has $p_{\mathrm{th}} = 0$ and $f = 1$, so the switch is neutral for it.

### Derivation

$$
k_j \leftarrow
\begin{cases}
f_j\, k_j, & p < p_{\mathrm{th},j},\\
k_j, & p \ge p_{\mathrm{th},j}.
\end{cases}
$$ {#eq-ch06-pressure-switch-factor}

@eq-ch06-pressure-switch-factor is computed in `switch_pressure`
({{< code src/kinetics/arrhenius.cpp ArrheniusImpl::switch_pressure >}}). It is exact. The derivative of $k_j$ with
respect to $p$ is not formed; $p$ is not a state variable of the Jacobian (@sec-ch06-jacobian).

### Numerical method

A `torch.where` on $p < p_{\mathrm{th}}$ selects $f k$ or $k$, element by element. The threshold and factor are
plain tensors, not module buffers, and are moved to the rate's device and dtype at each call.

The figure is not provided: the figure module is not written yet.

negative.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_coagulation_pressure_switch.py` | RK4 box matches $x_c(t) = x_{c0} e^{-k t}$ near $p_{\mathrm{th}}$ | $10^{-10}$ rel. | not yet derived |
| `test_coagulation_pressure_switch.py` | switch is strict at $p = p_{\mathrm{th}}$ | $10^{-15}$ rel. | round-off of one product |
| `test_coagulation_pressure_switch.py` | bad inputs raise | exact | error messages |

: Tests of the pressure switch. {#tbl-ch06-pressure-switch-tests}

The box test runs at $p_{\mathrm{th}}$ and one unit in the last place on either side. Tests run on CPU only.

### Limits

The switch is a step in $p$; a state that crosses the threshold during an implicit step sees the rate of the
starting pressure. Not measured.
